blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — Moro civic leaders and interfaith peace advocates across Mindanao on Wednesday condemned renewed Israeli military operations and ground incursions in Gaza, demanding an immediate halt to the offensive and the unconditional withdrawal of Israeli troops. In a statement, the Marawi-based Moro Consensus Group (MCG) said the fresh assault “violates existing ceasefire commitments” and has triggered another wave of forced displacement among already vulnerable Palestinian families. Drawing parallels to the 2017 Marawi siege, MCG chairperson Drieza A. Lininding said the Bangsamoro know all too well the toll of prolonged warfare on civilians. READ: PH airs concern over […]...
